audience: developers and teams who call open-weight models on their Cerebras account

useCases.title: See which models your account can use
useCases.text: List the models on your Cerebras account, then read one model's details before you choose it.

useCases.title: Ask a model for a reply
useCases.text: Send a chat conversation to a model you picked and read its reply with the token usage. Each call uses your Cerebras limits.

useCases.title: Check a model id before a batch job
useCases.text: Model ids change. Read one model by id before a batch job, to confirm the id still exists on your account.
